source: docs/ORCHESTRATION-DESIGN-2026-10.md section 3 (tier guide), whose tier rows ran and worked on 2026-11-01 (library record r57-0201); the owner's rulings r57-0005 and r57-0021. Effort levels are not checked yet.

locate.for: where is X: paths and lines, no judgment

extract.for: extraction from one file into a fixed schema, no inference, nothing across files

read.for: reading with light reasoning across files: maps, cross-references, citation checks

collect.for: collecting published sources and quoting them

run.for: running commands or checks and reporting what happened

build-invariant.for: invariant-sensitive code: fence, claim, lock, ledger, planner, hook

refute.for: refuting a claim or a design in a fresh context

orchestrate.for: a child session that coordinates its own helpers

test.for: a dummy session or helper that only tests something
